cases.title: handshake without Sec-WebSocket-Key or headers exceeding 8192 bytes closed
identity takeover by replaying another guestId replaces that session
cases.preconditions: attacker already has loopback reach to the bound socket (bind is 127.0.0.1, native/src/networking.cpp:2811); victim logged in with guessable guestId
cases.path: identity taken verbatim from payload, prior session replaced and old socket closed with player:session-replaced, native/src/networking.cpp:2984-2988
cases.risk: account/session hijack within the host; documented JS-parity anonymous-guest design, so treated as accepted-risk boundary needing an explicit policy decision, not a code change under this capsule

cases.title: deeply nested JSON text recurses JsonParser without depth limit up to the 16384-byte frame cap
cases.preconditions: single masked text frame from any connected client; parse happens pre-auth on the reader thread
cases.path: value/object/array mutual recursion native/src/networking.cpp:118-197 entered from handle_message->parse_envelope native/src/networking.cpp:2984->567; nesting count bounded only by frame cap 16384 native/src/networking.cpp:2828; MSVC default reader-thread stack ~1 MiB makes overflow plausible around tens of thousands of levels
cases.risk: stack-exhaustion crash of the server process; NO test covers nesting depth anywhere in native/tests; dynamic confirmation intentionally NOT performed (capsule forbids live fuzzing) - escalate for an owner-approved harness
cases.remediation_sketch: depth counter in JsonParser with hard cap plus iterative or depth-limited descent; add parser test for deep nesting

cases.title: road node id with oversized middle segment drives unbounded recursion via web_tier_width
cases.preconditions: single valid-envelope frame after any login; tier must fit int but only needs >=~50k to exceed default stack
cases.path: world:zone:enter handler native/src/networking.cpp:2386 -> parse_node_id validates only road prefix and tier>=1/index>=0 native/src/networking.cpp:805-816 -> enter_road_node native/src/networking.cpp:1517 calls web_road_nodes(house, road, tier+1) native/src/networking.cpp:1521 -> web_tier_width recursion depth equals tier native/src/networking.cpp:756-762; core dispatch leg is safe (unknown route rejected, native/src/core.cpp:540-541) so control reaches the web path directly
cases.risk: same crash family as PC-014: stack exhaustion kills the whole server process from one frame; also the node-building loop iterates max_tier times (memory amplification); no test sends hostile node ids
cases.remediation_sketch: clamp tier in parse_node_id to the chart frontier (or small constant); make web_tier_width iterative with memoization; add regression test

cases.title: non-finite and out-of-range numbers accepted by strtod then cast to int unchecked
cases.preconditions: payload numeric field set to INF/NAN-style token or magnitude beyond int range
cases.path: JsonParser::value uses strtod without range/finiteness checks native/src/networking.cpp:128-134 (MSVC strtod accepts inf/nan spellings); as_int static_cast<int>(double) native/src/networking.cpp:204-206 is undefined behavior outside int range; sinks include dev:setlevel native/src/networking.cpp:2390, dev:teleport 2389, dev:give itemLevel 1070
cases.risk: undefined-value casts (in practice platform-defined saturation) flowing into level/life math; dev:setlevel also computes 100+level*10 which can overflow signed int; deterministic per-platform but not pinned by tests

cases.title: dev:give quantity upper bound unclamped drives long-running item minting loop
cases.path: quantity=(max)(1,as_int(qty,1)) native/src/networking.cpp:1063 then per-unit create/add loop 1079-1087 spilling overflow ground items into world_ each iteration
cases.risk: single frame can drive minutes of CPU and unbounded ground-item memory growth inside the 16 KiB frame budget; no rate gate (B4) compounds it

cases.title: shop buy trusts client-echoed price including zero/negative values
cases.preconditions: crafted player:context-menu:action payload; guest economy context
cases.path: price read from payload item_ref as_int native/src/networking.cpp:1953; carried_gold()>=price passes for price<=0 and the deduction loop becomes a no-op while create_game_item still grants the item 1954-1969
cases.risk: free/negative-cost purchases; contained to the local guest economy by design (JS menu echo parity) but violates server-authoritative pricing expectations; no test pins price authority

cases.title: bank withdraw/deposit accept negative quantities corrupting stack counts
cases.preconditions: crafted action payload with negative qty against a stackable bank/inventory item
cases.path: withdraw: out.qty=qty inserted into inventory and bank_[i].qty -= qty inflates the bank stack native/src/networking.cpp:1985-1999; deposit mirrors it 2002-2009; no lower-bound check anywhere on these paths
cases.risk: item-count corruption (negative stacks, inflated banks) without crash; deterministic state corruption candidate lacking any test

cases.title: no per-connection message rate limit or flood control
cases.preconditions: local process able to open loopback connections
cases.path: handle_message processes every accepted frame synchronously native/src/networking.cpp:2984-2988; combat-driving events run process_combat inline 2507; tick thread additionally advances every session forever including disconnected ones because sessions_ entries are never evicted 2811/2822/2990
cases.risk: CPU amplification and unbounded session/memory growth per unique identity (each ProtocolSession allocates two simulations, native/src/networking.cpp:577-580); mitigated by loopback bind and dev-server context

summary.headline: two crash-class candidates (JSON nesting depth, road-node tier recursion) share one root cause class - unbounded recursion driven by client-controlled counts inside the 16 KiB frame budget - and neither has any test coverage
